zh.name: 百宝箱
zh.description: 常用浏览器小工具装进一个页面，打开即用。
zh.longDescription: 把日常开发与排查里高频用到的小工具收进同一个页面：随手测量、转换、调试，免安装、无多余步骤，需要时打开，用完即走。

en.name: Tool Shed
en.description: Everyday browser utilities in one page — open and go.
en.longDescription: A single page of daily web utilities for quick measuring, converting, and debugging. No install, no sign-up — open, use, close.

zh.name: Linux手册
zh.longDescription: 一键复制即用的 Linux 命令速查手册。

en.name: Linux Quick Reference
en.description: A quick reference for Linux commands — copy and paste.
en.longDescription: A quick reference for Linux commands — copy and paste.

zh.name: 拼贴画布
zh.description: 浏览器里的 Instagram 风网格拼图排版。
zh.longDescription: 拖入几张照片，按 Instagram 风格的网格排好版再导出——发九宫格之前，先把想发的效果定下来。

en.name: Collage Canvas
en.description: Instagram-style grid collages, right in the browser.
en.longDescription: Drop in photos, arrange an Instagram-style grid, then export — settle the look before you post.

zh.name: 无印良频
zh.description: 粘贴分享链接，解析无水印的视频下载地址。
zh.longDescription: 输入视频分享链接，解析出可下载的源地址，尽可能拿到无水印版本——适合备份收藏，或二次剪辑前收集素材。

en.name: No Watermark Video
en.description: Paste a share link, resolve a watermark-free download.
en.longDescription: Paste a share URL to get a downloadable source, preferring watermark-free versions when available — handy for archiving or re-editing.

zh.name: 算了吗
zh.description: 抽一张牌，看看牌面想说什么。
zh.longDescription: 不需要道具的三分钟塔罗：洗牌、抽牌、解义，再附上一句可以带走的建议。灵不灵，算过才知道。

en.name: Ask the Cards
en.description: Draw a card and see what it says.
en.longDescription: A no-prop three-minute reading: shuffle, draw, interpret — then walk away with one piece of advice worth keeping. Try it and find out.

zh.name: 午夜频道
zh.description: 按目标或素材反查 P4G 面具合成配方。
zh.longDescription: 面向《女神异闻录4 黄金版》的面具合成速查：从想要的面具反推素材，或从手上素材找可行组合，覆盖攻略表里最常翻的那几页。

en.name: Midnight Channel
en.description: Reverse-search Persona fusion recipes in Persona 4 Golden.
en.longDescription: A Persona 4 Golden helper — start from the Persona you want or the materials you have and get exact fusion routes, no guide spreadsheets required.

zh.name: 划词翻译
zh.longDescription: 划词翻译,支持多种翻译引擎,多种语言翻译,OCR识图翻译。

en.name: Look Translate
en.longDescription: A Windows word translation tool, supports multiple translation engines, OCR image translation, and multiple language translation.

zh.name: 搜索布局
zh.description: 谷歌 / 必应搜索结果单列或双列布局，支持自动翻页。
zh.longDescription: 把桌面版谷歌与必应网页搜索结果排成单列、单列居中或双列卡片，滚到底部自动接下页——不用再来回点页码。点扩展图标即可切换偏好，设置随 Chrome 账号同步。

en.name: SearchLayout
en.description: Single- or dual-column Google / Bing results with auto-paging.
en.longDescription: Rearrange desktop Google and Bing web results into single, centered, or dual-column cards, and load the next page as you scroll—no more clicking pagination. Switch layout from the toolbar icon; preferences sync with your Chrome account.
